title: Design System: Chatree Kengpipat — ERP Consultant Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero name lockup (.ck-signature) only — one per page.

body.purpose: Default prose, Inter 400 at 15px; cap measure 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Pills, tags, metric readouts — JetBrains Mono only.

shadows.name: shadow-md

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action; Implementation Blue fill that lifts and glows on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #fff; background: #2563eb; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 15px 30px -8px rgba(37,99,235,0.6), 0 0 25px rgba(37,99,235,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline stroke that shifts to accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0f172a; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { color: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb; background: #eff6ff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Flat surface card that lifts on hover; title shifts to accent.
components.html:
XEERSOFT CLOUD ERP

End-to-end Implementation

Configuration, master data, UAT and Go-live across a live project.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #2563eb; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #64748b; margin: 0; }

components.name: Meta Pill
components.description: Neutral mono pill for credentials/metrics; border shifts to accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 100px; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover { color: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px -3px rgba(37,99,235,0.35); }

components.description: The 'now / focus' marker — accent-tinted mono tag.

narrative.overview: The portfolio of an engineer-turned-ERP-consultant, with an interface that reads like an instrument panel: precise alignment, a restrained slate palette, monospace labels framing content like readouts, and a single decisive blue that behaves like a signal. Modern, technical, bold — bold in committed scale and a confident dark mode, never loud. Depth comes from tonal layering and interaction, not chrome: surfaces sit flat and come alive on hover and focus with a soft accent glow. It explicitly rejects the generic portfolio / AI-template look.
keyCharacteristics: Slate-neutral foundation with one Implementation Blue accent
Two-voice typography: Inter (prose) + JetBrains Mono (labels only)
Flat-by-default surfaces; accent glow appears on interaction
Full light/dark theme parity via a toggle
Monospace readouts frame content like an instrument console

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Implementation Blue is the only chromatic voice. Every other surface is a slate neutral. Emphasis comes from blue, weight, or scale, not a new color.

rules.name: The Twin-Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are first-class equals via [data-theme]. Any new color must be defined for both themes and hold contrast in each.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter for everything readable; JetBrains Mono only for labels, tags, and numeric readouts. Mono never sets a paragraph.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow and glow appear only in response to state (hover, focus, scrolled).

dos: Do keep Implementation Blue (#2563eb) as the only accent; carry everything else on slate neutrals.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for labels, tags, and readouts; set all prose in Inter.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let shadow/glow appear only on hover, focus, or scroll.
Do define every new color for both light and dark themes and verify body text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1 in each.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the animated tech-canvas background and any reveal must have a reduced/instant alternative.
Do lead with specific ERP evidence (module names, phases, live dashboards).
donts: Don't let it look like a generic portfolio or an AI-template / bought theme.
Don't use tiny tracked-uppercase eyebrows above every section, or numbered 01 / 02 / 03 section scaffolding.
Don't ship identical icon-heading-text card grids, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or the hero-metric template.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a side-stripe accent (the current .formula-block 3px stripe is this anti-pattern).
Don't use marketing buzzwords (streamline, empower, leverage, seamless, world-class).
Don't introduce a third type family or a second accent hue.
